requirements: R1: Implement Moodle SSO integration and backend role synchronization to return correct 200/201 instead of 401.
R2: Revert frontend E2E test stubs that swallowed authentication failures by improperly asserting 401/403.

slices.title: Resolve Moodle SSO Falsification Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing Moodle SSO fixes for this epic, I want to establish correct backend authentication and revert frontend E2E stubs, so that authenticated requests succeed and test passes reflect actual truth.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid Moodle SSO request,
When processed by the backend,
Then it must return 200/201 instead of 401.
Given the E2E tests (mock-semantic-boundary.spec.mjs),
When assertions are checked,
Then they must not swallow failures by accepting 401/403 states incorrectly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Authentication success rate and E2E true-positive rate
